subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Which open fix branch should be the canonical repair for this issue, and should the canonical scope include Telegram streamed preview-finalized replies before merge?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the remaining choice is branch scope and hook ownership semantics across channel delivery paths, which should not be decided by starting another automated fix PR from the issue.

options.title: Select the comprehensive branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as canonical if maintainers accept the `runsMessageSendingAtDelivery` ownership boundary and require rebase, out-of-draft cleanup, and final proof.

options.title: Land a narrow dispatcher fix first
options.body: Use a smaller dispatcher-only PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92762 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92976 while explicitly tracking streamed Telegram final coverage separately.

options.title: Request a replacement branch
options.body: Ask for a new narrower branch that covers both required paths without inheriting the current candidates' conflict or proof blockers.

recommendation.title: Select the comprehensive branch
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as canonical if maintainers accept the `runsMessageSendingAtDelivery` ownership boundary and require rebase, out-of-draft cleanup, and final proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent refactor history touch both dispatcher and Telegram lines, making this the best available routing owner from code history.
